scope: candidate-only durable delivery/effect handoff semantics on pinned N.E.K.O

reuse_findings.external_queue_or_workflow_engine: REJECTED_FOR_THIS_GAP; would duplicate the native commission/result authority rather than repair its effect boundary

candidate_semantics.delivery_handoff: sender durably leases the exact outbox row before transport; native send_report still returns bool and receives only an immutable payload copy carrying private delivery identity
candidate_semantics.delivery_claimed: main process durably claims the exact attempt before crossing the visible-effect boundary; retry is no longer automatically safe
candidate_semantics.delivery_uncertain: a claim survived without a confirmed effect receipt, including main/agent restart ambiguity; automatic effect retry is fenced
candidate_semantics.sent: exact positive receipt is terminal; replayed claim/release/failure cannot reopen it

main-process claim and effect receipt protocol
